title: Site Reliability Engineering: How Google Runs Production Systems

title: Observability Engineering: Achieving Production Excellence
authors: C. Majors, L. Fong-Jones, G. Miranda
evidence: Amazon listing confirms ISBN-13 9781492076445, authors Majors/Fong-Jones/Miranda; O'Reilly catalog page 9781492076438 (ebook ISBN) corroborates title and May 2022 publication.

title: OpenTelemetry Specification
evidence: Live fetch of opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/ confirms current version 1.61.0 and scope: cross-language API/SDK spec for traces, metrics, logs, context/baggage propagation.
note: The vendor-neutral specification that standardizes instrumentation for traces/metrics/logs across languages — the canonical primary source for observability tooling; anchor of the tools-process leg of runtime-ops.

title: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions
evidence: Live fetch confirms page as the official semantic conventions spec, v1.44.0, defining common attribute names across HTTP, DB, messaging, cloud, CI/CD, feature-flag domains for traces/metrics/logs.
note: Defines the shared vocabulary (attribute names/values) that makes cross-vendor telemetry interoperable and queryable — a governance layer within the observability tooling stack.

note: The standardized HTTP header format (traceparent/tracestate) that lets distributed traces cross vendor and service boundaries; adopted as the propagation format underlying OpenTelemetry.
